name: Macau street scene with the towers of S. Lourenço Church
summary: At the end of the street is the flight of steps leading up to the church of S. Lourenço, Macau, whose twin towers can be seen above.  Among the figures is a vendor weighing out his produce (by the wall), and a pair of Macanese women advancing with their servant behind..

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
